integrity: Standalone integer combinatorial and symmetry checks supplied; universal proof is mathematical, not a finite census.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the coordinate dihedral subgroup for toroidal grids with both circumferences at least five. Nonequivariant homotopy and Betti-number results are prior literature. Published overlap checks do not exclude an unindexed equivalent result.
title: A nonsplit integral reflection lattice in toroidal closed-neighborhood homology
